# FLX-6205: an interval open on one side with nothing declared to draw it

**Family:** expression language (the 6000 band)

A value drawn inside an interval that has no upper end needs a declared draw over it. A date that `within` sets, in a run with no `spec.timeBounds`, is drawn inside its parent's lifetime, which is open when the parent has no end: the entry then declares an `offset` with a positive weight on a day from 0 up, or the run declares its time bounds. A row whose interval has no upper end and whose offset keeps no value inside it is refused as well.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-6205
```
